hero.subtitle: Our goal is to educate and empower parents so they can better understand how to create a long-term healing environment for their children, at no out-of-pocket cost to AAP families.

approach.title: What is Trauma-Informed, High-Fidelity Wraparound Support?
approach.intro: At Love Pathways, true healing doesn’t come from a one-size-fits-all manual. We build a safety net around your family's unique reality through trauma-informed care coordination.

block1.title: Empowering Your Voice
block1.desc: Our foundation is built entirely on family voice and choice. Your personalized care plan is family-driven, deeply individualized to your specific needs, and completely culturally respectful to your traditions.

block2.title: Building Your Village
block2.desc: A dedicated care coordinator holds your family-centered team together. Professionals work alongside you, and we integrate natural supports (friends, neighbors) so community integration is part of the plan, not an afterthought.

block3.title: Relentless Commitment
block3.desc: We are strictly outcomes-based, with progress monitoring against clear goals. Above all, our promise is persistence: we work alongside you through every challenge until you reach a better place.

gettingStarted.title: How do I get started with Love Pathways Wraparound?
gettingStarted.quote: "We consider it a successful outcome when the family feels empowered."

requestSupport.title: Request Support
requestSupport.desc: Wraparound services can be requested by members of the immediate family.

completeForm.title: Complete Initial Form
completeForm.desc: Once the initial form is completed, a representative will be in touch to discuss the program and explain the requirements.

consultation.title: Initial Consultation
consultation.desc: We'll discuss your specific situation and how the Fear to Love model, developed by Bryan Post, can best support your family.

phases.title: The 4 Phases of Wraparound Care
phases.intro: Following your initial consultation, our High Fidelity Wraparound model kicks in. We use four distinct phases to guide and support your family's journey toward independence.
phases.label: Phase

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.desc: Focused on listening to your story, building trust, and identifying your support team.

planDevelopment.title: Plan Development
planDevelopment.desc: Building your personalized care plan around your culture and unique strengths.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.desc: Putting the plan into action, with ongoing progress monitoring and adjustments made with your team.

transition.title: Transition
transition.desc: Preparing for independence through community integration and stronger natural supports.

reach.description: We've strategically expanded our footprint to ensure that no adoptive family in Northern and Central California has to walk their journey alone.
reach.cardDescription: Our mission is to reach every family in need. If you reside outside these counties, please reach out. We are constantly evaluating new areas for expansion to bring healing where it's needed most.
reach.mapTitle: Map of the 10 California counties served by Love Pathways Wraparound
reach.mapDesc: Love Pathways Wraparound serves families across 10 counties in California. Each served county is filled in and marked with a pin.
